```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(patchwork)
library(ggplot2)

# === PARAMETERS ===
celltype_name <- "BasalIV"
genes_of_interest <- c("CDH13", "NFIA", "MEF2A", "TP63", "FGFR2", "SLC24A3","SEMA3C","KRT14")  # Human homologs
genes_of_interest <- c("KIF15", "CENPE", "TPX2", "ANLN", "KNL1", "KIF20B", "ECT2", "TOP2A", "MKI67", "IGFBP3", "PECAM1","CDH5")
max_value <- 0.8
score_name <- paste0(celltype_name, "_Score")
image_region <- "slice1"  # update as per your image slot name
pt_size <- 2.5

for (sample_name in names(spatial_human)) {
  obj <- spatial_human[[sample_name]]
  present_genes <- genes_of_interest[genes_of_interest %in% rownames(obj)]
  cat(sample_name, "has", length(present_genes), "of", length(genes_of_interest), "genes present.\n")
}



for (sample_name in names(spatial_human)) {
  obj <- spatial_human[[sample_name]]
  
  # Just add module score, assuming data is normalized
  obj <- AddModuleScore(obj,
                        features = list(genes_of_interest),
                        name = score_name,
                        assay = "SCT", 
                        nbin = 10)
  
  spatial_human[[sample_name]] <- obj
}

# Assuming these parameters are already defined:
# celltype_name, genes_of_interest, score_name, max_value, image_region, pt_size

score_column <- paste0(score_name, "1")

# Function to plot spatial scores for a given Seurat object with label
plot_spatial_score <- function(obj, label) {
  SpatialFeaturePlot(
    obj,
    features = score_column,
    images = image_region,
    pt.size.factor = pt_size * 2,
    min.cutoff = 0,
    max.cutoff = max_value
  ) + ggtitle(label) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
}

# List of sample names grouped by your desired "timepoints"
# (You will need to adjust these vectors based on your sample naming and grouping)
samples_d0 <- c("P20063_109", "P17401_1001","P20063_101","P20063_105")  # example samples for D0
samples_d3 <- c("P20063_110", "P17401_1002","P20063_102","P20063_106")  # example samples for D3
samples_d7 <- c("P20063_111", "P17401_1003","P20063_103","P20063_107") # example samples for D7
samples_d30 <- c("P20063_112", "P17401_1004","P20063_104","P20063_108") # example samples for D30

# Helper function to generate plots for a group of samples and combine them
plot_and_combine_group <- function(sample_names, group_label) {
  plots <- list()
  for (sample in sample_names) {
    obj <- spatial_human[[sample]]
    p <- plot_spatial_score(obj, paste(celltype_name, "-", group_label, sample))
    plots[[sample]] <- p
  }
  combined <- wrap_plots(plots, ncol = 2)
  
  dir.create("human_spatial_module_score_plots", showWarnings = FALSE)
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0("human_spatial_module_score_plots/", score_name, "_", group_label, "_combinedBiggerDotSize.png"),
    plot = combined,
    width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 320
  )
  return(combined)
}

# Generate combined plots for each timepoint group
combined_d0 <- plot_and_combine_group(samples_d0, "D0")
combined_d3 <- plot_and_combine_group(samples_d3, "D1")
combined_d7 <- plot_and_combine_group(samples_d7, "D7")
combined_d30 <- plot_and_combine_group(samples_d30, "D30")

# Optionally, combine all timepoints into one big plot
all_combined <- (combined_d0 | combined_d3) / (combined_d7 | combined_d30)
ggsave(
  filename = paste0("human_spatial_module_score_plots/", score_name, "_all_timepoints_combinedBiggerDotSize.png"),
  plot = all_combined,
  width = 16, height = 14, dpi = 320
)
```

```{r}
# Define your endothelial markers


human_endothelial_markers <- c("KRT14")
pt_size <- 2.5

library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)  # for combining plots

# Define output directory
output_dir <- "SpatialFeaturePlots"
dir.create(output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Get condition (timepoint) for each sample
sample_conditions <- sapply(spatial_human, function(obj) unique(obj$Condition))
samples_by_condition <- split(names(spatial_human), sample_conditions)

# Helper function to generate plots for a group of samples for one gene
plot_and_combine_group <- function(sample_names, group_label, gene) {
  plots <- list()
  for (sample in sample_names) {
    obj <- spatial_human[[sample]]
    if (gene %in% rownames(obj)) {
      p <- SpatialFeaturePlot(
        obj,
        features = gene,
        pt.size.factor = pt_size *1.5
      ) +
        ggtitle(paste0(sample)) +
        theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"))
      plots[[sample]] <- p
    }
  }
  if (length(plots) > 0) {
    combined <- wrap_plots(plots, ncol = 2)
    dir.create("SpatialFeaturePlots", showWarnings = FALSE)
    ggsave(
      filename = paste0("SpatialFeaturePlots/", gene, "_", group_label, "_combined.png"),
      plot = combined,
      width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 320
    )
    return(combined)
  } else {
    return(NULL)
  }
}

# Loop through each gene and make per-timepoint + all-timepoint plots
for (gene in human_endothelial_markers) {
  
  # Store per-timepoint plots
  timepoint_plots <- list()
  
  for (condition in names(samples_by_condition)) {
    combined_plot <- plot_and_combine_group(samples_by_condition[[condition]], condition, gene)
    if (!is.null(combined_plot)) {
      timepoint_plots[[condition]] <- combined_plot
    }
  }
  
  # Combine all timepoints into one big patchwork layout (if at least one exists)
  if (length(timepoint_plots) > 0) {
    # Arrange in a nice grid (2x2 if 4 timepoints)
    all_combined <- wrap_plots(timepoint_plots, ncol = 2) +
      plot_annotation(
        title = paste0("Gene: ", gene, " | All Timepoints"),
        theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"))
      )
    
    ggsave(
      filename = paste0("SpatialFeaturePlots/", gene, "_all_timepoints_combined.png"),
      plot = all_combined,
      width = 16, height = 14, dpi = 320
    )
  }
}
```

```{r Quantification of SEma3c Expression}
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(ggpubr)
library(khroma)

# Define timepoint groups
samples_d0 <- c("P20063_109", "P17401_1001", "P20063_101", "P20063_105")
samples_d1 <- c("P20063_110", "P17401_1002", "P20063_102", "P20063_106")
samples_d7 <- c("P20063_111", "P17401_1003", "P20063_103", "P20063_107")
samples_d30 <- c("P20063_112", "P17401_1004", "P20063_104", "P20063_108")

# Map samples to timepoints with correct lengths and factor levels for ordering
sample_timepoint_map <- data.frame(
  sample = c(samples_d0, samples_d1, samples_d7, samples_d30),
  timepoint = factor(
    c(
      rep("D0", length(samples_d0)),
      rep("D1", length(samples_d1)),
      rep("D7", length(samples_d7)),
      rep("D30", length(samples_d30))
    ),
    levels = c("D0", "D1", "D7", "D30")  # Set desired order here
  )
)

# Extract SEMA3C expression from SCT assay for each sample
expr_data <- lapply(names(spatial_human), function(sample_name) {
  if (sample_name %in% sample_timepoint_map$sample) {
    obj <- spatial_human[[sample_name]]
    DefaultAssay(obj) <- "SCT"
    if ("SEMA3C" %in% rownames(obj)) {
      data.frame(
        sample = sample_name,
        expression = FetchData(obj, vars = "SEMA3C")[, 1]
      )
    } else {
      NULL
    }
  }
}) %>% bind_rows()

# Add timepoint labels
expr_data <- left_join(expr_data, sample_timepoint_map, by = "sample")

# Generate the palette and assign names
timepoint_colors <- color("nightfall")(4)[1:4]
names(timepoint_colors) <- c("D0", "D1", "D7", "D30")

# Create violin plot with Wilcoxon test comparing to D0
p <- ggplot(expr_data, aes(x = timepoint, y = expression, fill = timepoint)) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, outlier.size = 0.5, fill = "white") +
  stat_compare_means(
    method = "wilcox.test",
    label = "p.signif",
    ref.group = "D0"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +  # You can swap theme_ggprism_mod if defined
  ylab("SEMA3C Expression (SCT)") +
  xlab("Timepoint") +
  ggtitle("SEMA3C Expression Across Timepoints Human Spatial") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = timepoint_colors)

print(p)

ggsave("MeanSEMA3CVlnPlotExpressionSpatial.png", height =4, width = 4)
```

```{r}
library(Seurat)

# Your sample groups (same as before)
samples_d0 <- c("P20063_109", "P17401_1001", "P20063_101", "P20063_105")
samples_d1 <- c("P20063_110", "P17401_1002", "P20063_102", "P20063_106")
samples_d7 <- c("P20063_111", "P17401_1003", "P20063_103", "P20063_107")
samples_d30 <- c("P20063_112", "P17401_1004", "P20063_104", "P20063_108")

sample_timepoint_map <- data.frame(
  sample = c(samples_d0, samples_d1, samples_d7, samples_d30),
  timepoint = factor(
    c(
      rep("D0", length(samples_d0)),
      rep("D1", length(samples_d1)),
      rep("D7", length(samples_d7)),
      rep("D30", length(samples_d30))
    ),
    levels = c("D0", "D1", "D7", "D30")
  )
)



# Extract SEMA3C expression only in spots with KRT14 > 0
expr_data_krt14 <- lapply(names(spatial_human), function(sample_name) {
  if (sample_name %in% sample_timepoint_map$sample) {
    obj <- spatial_human[[sample_name]]
    DefaultAssay(obj) <- "SCT"
    
    # Check genes present
    genes_present <- rownames(obj)
    if (all(c("SEMA3C", "KRT5") %in% genes_present)) {
      data_mat <- FetchData(obj, vars = c("SEMA3C", "KRT5"))
      data_mat_filtered <- data_mat[data_mat$KRT5 > 2, ]  # only spots with KRT14 > 0
      
      data.frame(
        sample = sample_name,
        expression = data_mat_filtered$SEMA3C
      )
    } else {
      NULL
    }
  }
}) %>% bind_rows()

# Add timepoint labels
expr_data_krt14 <- left_join(expr_data_krt14, sample_timepoint_map, by = "sample")

# Set up color palette again
timepoint_colors <- color("nightfall")(4)[1:4]
names(timepoint_colors) <- c("D0", "D1", "D7", "D30")

# Plot violin plot with stats comparing to D0
p_krt14 <- ggplot(expr_data_krt14, aes(x = timepoint, y = expression, fill = timepoint)) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, outlier.size = 0.5, fill = "white") +
  stat_compare_means(
    method = "wilcox.test",
    label = "p.signif",
    ref.group = "D0"
  ) +
  theme_ggprism_mod(base_size = 14) +
  ylab("SEMA3C Expression in KRT14+ Spots (SCT)") +
  xlab("Timepoint") +
  ggtitle("SEMA3C Expression in Epidermal Spots Across Timepoints vs D0") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = timepoint_colors)

print(p_krt14)

ggsave("MeanSEMA3CVlnPlotExpressionSpatialKrt5.png", height =4, width = 4)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

sample_means_krt14 <- lapply(names(spatial_human), function(sample_name) {

    DefaultAssay(obj) <- "SCT"

    if (all(c("SEMA3C", "KRT5") %in% rownames(obj))) {

      sema3c_expr <- FetchData(obj, vars = "SEMA3C")[,1]
      
      # Define KRT14+ spots
      krt14_pos_spots <- which(krt14_expr > 2)
      
      if(length(krt14_pos_spots) > 0){
        mean_sema3c_krt14pos <- mean(sema3c_expr[krt14_pos_spots])
      } else {
        mean_sema3c_krt14pos <- NA
      }
      
      data.frame(
        sample = sample_name,
        mean_SEMA3C_KRT14pos = mean_sema3c_krt14pos
      )
    } else {
      NULL
    }
  }
}) %>% bind_rows()
```

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(khroma)

# Define sample groups
samples_d0 <- c("P20063_109", "P17401_1001", "P20063_101", "P20063_105")
samples_d1 <- c("P20063_110", "P17401_1002", "P20063_102", "P20063_106")
samples_d7 <- c("P20063_111", "P17401_1003", "P20063_103", "P20063_107")
samples_d30 <- c("P20063_112", "P17401_1004", "P20063_104", "P20063_108")

sample_timepoint_map <- data.frame(
  sample = c(samples_d0, samples_d1, samples_d7, samples_d30),
  timepoint = factor(
    c(
      rep("D0", length(samples_d0)),
      rep("D1", length(samples_d1)),
      rep("D7", length(samples_d7)),
      rep("D30", length(samples_d30))
    ),
    levels = c("D0", "D1", "D7", "D30")
  )
)

# -----------------------------
# Extract raw SEMA3C expression + region info
# -----------------------------
expr_data_region <- lapply(names(spatial_human), function(sample_name) {
  if (sample_name %in% sample_timepoint_map$sample) {
    obj <- spatial_human[[sample_name]]
    DefaultAssay(obj) <- "SCT"

    if ("SEMA3C" %in% rownames(obj) && "AnnoType" %in% colnames(obj@meta.data)) {
      data_mat <- FetchData(obj, vars = c("SEMA3C", "AnnoType"))
      data.frame(
        sample = sample_name,
        expression = data_mat$SEMA3C,
        region = data_mat$AnnoType
      )
    } else {
      NULL
    }
  }
}) %>% bind_rows()

# Add timepoint info
expr_data_region <- left_join(expr_data_region, sample_timepoint_map, by = "sample")

# -----------------------------
# Plot: Grouped violins by timepoint & region
# -----------------------------
timepoint_colors <- color("nightfall")(4)[1:4]
names(timepoint_colors) <- c("D0", "D1", "D7", "D30")

p_region <- ggplot(expr_data_region, aes(x = region, y = expression, fill = timepoint)) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE, scale = "width", alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), outlier.size = 0.3, fill = "white") +
  stat_compare_means(
    aes(group = timepoint),
    method = "wilcox.test",
    label = "p.signif",
    ref.group = "D0"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = timepoint_colors) +
  theme_ggprism_mod(base_size = 14) +
  xlab("Region (AnnoType)") +
  ylab("SEMA3C Expression (SCT)") +
  ggtitle("SEMA3C Expression Across Annotated Regions and Timepoints") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))

print(p_region)

ggsave("SEMA3C_Expression_By_Region_Timepoint.png", height = 5, width = 6, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(khroma)

# ==============================
# Define sample groups
# ==============================
samples_d0 <- c("P20063_109", "P17401_1001", "P20063_101", "P20063_105")
samples_d1 <- c("P20063_110", "P17401_1002", "P20063_102", "P20063_106")
samples_d7 <- c("P20063_111", "P17401_1003", "P20063_103", "P20063_107")
samples_d30 <- c("P20063_112", "P17401_1004", "P20063_104", "P20063_108")

sample_timepoint_map <- data.frame(
  sample = c(samples_d0, samples_d1, samples_d7, samples_d30),
  timepoint = factor(
    c(
      rep("D0", length(samples_d0)),
      rep("D1", length(samples_d1)),
      rep("D7", length(samples_d7)),
      rep("D30", length(samples_d30))
    ),
    levels = c("D0", "D1", "D7", "D30")
  )
)

# ==============================
# Extract raw SEMA3C expression + region info
# ==============================
expr_data_region <- lapply(names(spatial_human), function(sample_name) {
  if (sample_name %in% sample_timepoint_map$sample) {
    obj <- spatial_human[[sample_name]]
    DefaultAssay(obj) <- "SCT"
    
    if ("SEMA3C" %in% rownames(obj) && "AnnoType" %in% colnames(obj@meta.data)) {
      data_mat <- FetchData(obj, vars = c("SEMA3C", "AnnoType"))
      data.frame(
        sample = sample_name,
        expression = data_mat$SEMA3C,
        region = data_mat$AnnoType
      )
    } else {
      NULL
    }
  }
}) %>% bind_rows()

# Add timepoint info
expr_data_region <- left_join(expr_data_region, sample_timepoint_map, by = "sample")

# ==============================
# Calculate mean expression per region, timepoint, and sample
# ==============================
sample_means <- expr_data_region %>%
  group_by(timepoint, region, sample) %>%
  summarise(mean_expression = mean(expression, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# ==============================
# Calculate overall mean and SEM per region & timepoint
# ==============================
mean_expr <- sample_means %>%
  group_by(timepoint, region) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_expression = mean(mean_expression, na.rm = TRUE),
    sem = sd(mean_expression, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ==============================
# Plot: Bar plot (mean ± SEM) + sample points
# ==============================
timepoint_colors <- color("nightfall")(4)[1:4]
names(timepoint_colors) <- c("D0", "D1", "D7", "D30")

p_bar <- ggplot(mean_expr, aes(x = region, y = mean_expression, fill = timepoint)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
           color = "black", width = 0.8) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_expression - sem, ymax = mean_expression + sem),
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), width = 0.3, linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_point(
    data = sample_means,
    aes(x = region, y = mean_expression, color = timepoint),
    position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15, dodge.width = 0.9),
    size = 1.2, alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = timepoint_colors) +
  scale_color_manual(values = timepoint_colors) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  xlab("Region (AnnoType)") +
  ylab("Mean SEMA3C Expression (SCT)") +
  ggtitle("Mean ± SEM SEMA3C Expression by Region and Timepoint") +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

print(p_bar)

ggsave("SEMA3C_MeanExpression_By_Region_Timepoint_with_SEM.png",
       height = 5, width = 7, dpi = 300)


ggsave("SEMA3C_MeanExpression_By_Region_Timepoint_with_SEM.svg",
       height = 5, width = 7, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
      rep("D1", length(samples_d1)),
      rep("D7", length(samples_d7)),

        expr_vals <- data_mat$SEMA3C[data_mat$AnnoType == "Basal_epi"]
      }
      
      mean_expr <- if(length(expr_vals) > 0) mean(expr_vals, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_
      
      data.frame(
        sample = sample_name,
        mean_expression = mean_expr
      )
    } else {
      NULL
    }
  }
}) %>% bind_rows()

# Add timepoint info

# Wilcoxon test vs D0 (Basal_epi)

comparisons <- list(c("D0","D1"), c("D0","D7"), c("D0","D30"))

p_bar_we <- p_bar_we +
```

```{r}
# ==========================
# Setup

library(Seurat)

library(ggpubr)

# ==========================
# Define sample groups
# ==========================
samples_d0 <- c("P20063_109", "P17401_1001", "P20063_101", "P20063_105")
samples_d1 <- c("P20063_110", "P17401_1002", "P20063_102", "P20063_106")
samples_d7 <- c("P20063_111", "P17401_1003", "P20063_103", "P20063_107")

sample_timepoint_map <- data.frame(

      rep("D1", length(samples_d1)),

    ),

)

    if (sample_name %in% sample_timepoint_map$sample) {
      obj <- spatial_human[[sample_name]]
      DefaultAssay(obj) <- "SCT"
      
      if (gene %in% rownames(obj) && "AnnoType" %in% colnames(obj@meta.data)) {
        data_mat <- FetchData(obj, vars = c(gene, "AnnoType"))
        
        # Basal_epi for D0, Wound_edge for others
        if (sample_name %in% samples_d0) {
          expr_vals <- data_mat[[gene]][data_mat$AnnoType == "Basal_epi"]
        } else {
          expr_vals <- data_mat[[gene]][data_mat$AnnoType == "Wound_edges"]
        }
        
        mean_expr <- if (length(expr_vals) > 0) mean(expr_vals, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_
        
        data.frame(
          sample = sample_name,
          mean_expression = mean_expr
        )
      } else {
        NULL
      }
    }
  }) %>% bind_rows()
  
  # Add timepoint info
  sample_means <- left_join(sample_means, sample_timepoint_map, by = "sample")
  
  # ==========================
  # Plot mean ± SEM + jitter
  # ==========================
  p_gene <- ggplot(sample_means, aes(x = timepoint, y = mean_expression, fill = timepoint)) +

    ggtitle(paste0(gene, " Expression in Wound Edge (vs D0 Basal_epi)")) +

    stat_compare_means(
      comparisons = list(c("D0","D1"), c("D0","D7"), c("D0","D30")),

  print(p_gene)
  
  # ==========================
  # Save outputs

  ggsave(paste0(gene, "_WoundEdge_vsD0BasalEpi_BarPlot_perSample.svg"), p_gene, height = 5, width = 5, dpi = 300)
}
```

```{r}
plot_gene_timecourse <- function(
  gene,
  spatial_obj,
  sample_timepoint_map,
  samples_d0,
  anno_type = "Basal_epi",
  assay = "SCT",
  outdir = "."
) {

  message("Processing gene: ", gene)

  # ------------------------------
  # Compute per-sample mean
  # ------------------------------
  sample_means <- lapply(names(spatial_obj), function(sample_name) {

    if (!sample_name %in% sample_timepoint_map$sample) return(NULL)

    obj <- spatial_obj[[sample_name]]
    DefaultAssay(obj) <- assay

    if (!gene %in% rownames(obj)) return(NULL)
    if (!"AnnoType" %in% colnames(obj@meta.data)) return(NULL)

    data_mat <- FetchData(obj, vars = c(gene, "AnnoType"))

    expr_vals <- data_mat[[gene]][data_mat$AnnoType == anno_type]

    mean_expr <- if (length(expr_vals) > 0) {
      mean(expr_vals, na.rm = TRUE)
    } else {
      NA_real_
    }

    data.frame(
      sample = sample_name,
      mean_expression = mean_expr
    )
  }) %>% bind_rows()

  # Add timepoint info
  sample_means <- left_join(
    sample_means,
    sample_timepoint_map,
    by = "sample"
  )

  # ------------------------------
  # Plot
  # ------------------------------
  timepoint_colors <- khroma::color("nightfall")(4)[1:4]
  names(timepoint_colors) <- c("D0", "D1", "D7", "D30")

  comparisons <- list(
    c("D0", "D1"),
    c("D0", "D7"),
    c("D0", "D30")
  )

  p <- ggplot(
    sample_means,
    aes(x = timepoint, y = mean_expression, fill = timepoint)
  ) +
    stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "bar", color = "black", width = 0.7) +
    stat_summary(fun.data = mean_se, geom = "errorbar", width = 0.2) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 3, color = "black") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = timepoint_colors) +
    labs(
      x = "Timepoint",
      y = paste("Mean", gene, "Expression"),
      title = paste0(gene, " Expression in ", anno_type, " Across Timepoints")
    ) +
    theme_ggprism_mod(base_size = 14) +
    stat_compare_means(
      comparisons = comparisons,
      method = "wilcox.test",
      label = "p.signif"
    )

  # ------------------------------
  # Save
  # ------------------------------
  ggsave(
    file.path(outdir, paste0(gene, "_", anno_type, "_perSample.png")),
    p,
    height = 5,
    width = 5,
    dpi = 300
  )

  ggsave(
    file.path(outdir, paste0(gene, "_", anno_type, "_perSample.svg")),
    p,
    height = 5,
    width = 5
  )

  return(p)
}


genes_to_plot <- c(
  "SEMA3C",
  "SOX6",
  "NRP1",
  "NRP2",
  "PLXNA4",
  "PLXNA2",
"SOX6","SEMA3C","ITGA5","MKI67","TSPEAR","IL20RA"
)

plots <- lapply(genes_to_plot, function(g) {
  plot_gene_timecourse(
    gene = g,
    spatial_obj = spatial_human,
    sample_timepoint_map = sample_timepoint_map,
    samples_d0 = samples_d0,
    anno_type = "Basal_epi",
    outdir = "Gene_Timecourse_Plots"
  )
})

names(plots) <- genes_to_plot
```

```{r}
plot_gene_timecourse_global <- function(
  gene,
  spatial_obj,
  sample_timepoint_map,
  assay = "SCT",
  outdir = "."
) {

  message("Processing gene (global): ", gene)

  # ------------------------------
  # Compute per-sample mean (ALL cells)
  # ------------------------------
  sample_means <- lapply(names(spatial_obj), function(sample_name) {

    if (!sample_name %in% sample_timepoint_map$sample) return(NULL)

    obj <- spatial_obj[[sample_name]]
    DefaultAssay(obj) <- assay

    if (!gene %in% rownames(obj)) return(NULL)

    expr_vals <- FetchData(obj, vars = gene)[[gene]]

    mean_expr <- if (length(expr_vals) > 0) {
      mean(expr_vals, na.rm = TRUE)
    } else {
      NA_real_
    }

    data.frame(
      sample = sample_name,
      mean_expression = mean_expr
    )
  }) %>% bind_rows()

  # Add timepoint info
  sample_means <- left_join(
    sample_means,
    sample_timepoint_map,
    by = "sample"
  )

  # ------------------------------
  # Plot
  # ------------------------------
  timepoint_colors <- khroma::color("nightfall")(4)[1:4]
  names(timepoint_colors) <- c("D0", "D1", "D7", "D30")

  comparisons <- list(
    c("D0", "D1"),
    c("D0", "D7"),
    c("D0", "D30")
  )

  p <- ggplot(
    sample_means,
    aes(x = timepoint, y = mean_expression, fill = timepoint)
  ) +
    stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "bar", color = "black", width = 0.7) +
    stat_summary(fun.data = mean_se, geom = "errorbar", width = 0.2) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 3, color = "black") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = timepoint_colors) +
    labs(
      x = "Timepoint",
      y = paste("Mean", gene, "Expression"),
      title = paste0(gene, " Global Expression Across Timepoints")
    ) +
    theme_ggprism_mod(base_size = 14) +
    stat_compare_means(
      comparisons = comparisons,
      method = "wilcox.test",
      label = "p.signif"
    )

  # ------------------------------
  # Save
  # ------------------------------
  ggsave(
    file.path(outdir, paste0(gene, "_Global_perSample.png")),
    p,
    height = 5,
    width = 5,
    dpi = 300
  )

  ggsave(
    file.path(outdir, paste0(gene, "_Global_perSample.svg")),
    p,
    height = 5,
    width = 5
  )

  return(p)
}
```

```{r}
plot_gene_timecourse <- function(
  gene,
  spatial_obj,
  sample_timepoint_map,
  samples_d0,
  anno_type = "Wounded_edges",
  assay = "SCT",
  outdir = "."
) {

  message("Processing gene: ", gene)

  # ------------------------------
  # Compute per-sample mean
  # ------------------------------
  sample_means <- lapply(names(spatial_obj), function(sample_name) {

    if (!sample_name %in% sample_timepoint_map$sample) return(NULL)

    obj <- spatial_obj[[sample_name]]
    DefaultAssay(obj) <- assay

    if (!gene %in% rownames(obj)) return(NULL)

    meta <- obj@meta.data
    data_mat <- FetchData(obj, vars = gene)

    # Identify timepoint
    tp <- sample_timepoint_map$timepoint[
      sample_timepoint_map$sample == sample_name
    ]

    # ------------------------------
    # D0: global expression
    # ------------------------------
    if (tp == "D0") {
      expr_vals <- data_mat[[gene]]

    # ------------------------------
    # Other timepoints: wound edge only
    # ------------------------------
    } else {
      if (!"AnnoType" %in% colnames(meta)) return(NULL)

      data_mat$AnnoType <- meta$AnnoType
      expr_vals <- data_mat[[gene]][data_mat$AnnoType == anno_type]
    }

    mean_expr <- if (length(expr_vals) > 0) {
      mean(expr_vals, na.rm = TRUE)
    } else {
      NA_real_
    }

    data.frame(
      sample = sample_name,
      mean_expression = mean_expr
    )
  }) %>% bind_rows()

  # ------------------------------
  # Add timepoint info
  # ------------------------------
  sample_means <- left_join(
    sample_means,
    sample_timepoint_map,
    by = "sample"
  )

  # ------------------------------
  # Plot
  # ------------------------------
  timepoint_colors <- khroma::color("nightfall")(4)[1:4]
  names(timepoint_colors) <- c("D0", "D1", "D7", "D30")

  comparisons <- list(
    c("D0", "D1"),
    c("D0", "D7"),
    c("D0", "D30")
  )

  p <- ggplot(
    sample_means,
    aes(x = timepoint, y = mean_expression, fill = timepoint)
  ) +
    stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "bar", color = "black", width = 0.7) +
    stat_summary(fun.data = mean_se, geom = "errorbar", width = 0.2) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 3, color = "black") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = timepoint_colors) +
    labs(
      x = "Timepoint",
      y = paste("Mean", gene, "Expression"),
      title = paste0(
        gene,
        " Expression (D0 = global, others = ",
        anno_type,
        ")"
      )
    ) +
    theme_ggprism_mod(base_size = 14) +
    stat_compare_means(
      comparisons = comparisons,
      method = "wilcox.test",
      label = "p.signif"
    )

  # ------------------------------
  # Save
  # ------------------------------
  ggsave(
    file.path(outdir, paste0(gene, "_", anno_type, "_perSample.png")),
    p,
    height = 5,
    width = 5,
    dpi = 300
  )

  ggsave(
    file.path(outdir, paste0(gene, "_", anno_type, "_perSample.svg")),
    p,
    height = 5,
    width = 5
  )

  return(p)
}
```
